messages:
anya: idea for onboarding: a "lighthouse" path that surfaces 3 high-impact tasks as a horizontal progress pill under the header, expanding into a full checklist only when clicked. aim: low visual weight but clear first-run guidance. want UX + a11y + eng tradeoffs.

kevin: sounds promising. low weight helps not overwhelm users landing on console. question: pill vs strip? pill is less tall but might be missed. strip is more visible but takes real estate.

marta: data: users who see a persistent, slim affordance complete onboarding at higher rates than transient banners. recommend pill by default with an accessible visual affordance (dot + %). include a lightweight snooze.

oliver: a11y notes: if the pill only reveals content on click, ensure the expanded region receives focus and has role="region" with aria-labelledby. also include a visible focus target on the pill itself and a focus sentinel inside the expanded panel to trap keyboard users. avoid using aria-live for the percentage updates.

sam: microcopy thoughts: pill text "3 steps to finish setup" vs "Get started: 3 tasks". shorter is better. CTA inside expanded checklist: "Finish step" vs "Mark done"? prefer "Mark done" for clarity.

kevin: engineering concerns: avoid unmounting the checklist to preserve keyboard focus and state. we can keep it in DOM and toggle via aria-hidden. simple CSS approach below to keep animations composite-only:

```css
.lighthouse-pill { position: relative; display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.lighthouse-panel { max-height: 0; overflow: hidden; transition: max-height 220ms ease; }
.lighthouse-panel[aria-hidden="false"] { max-height: 480px; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .lighthouse-panel { transition: none; } }
```

oliver: okay but prefer transform/opacity for motion instead of max-height to avoid layout reflow; if we keep in DOM set aria-hidden when collapsed. also ensure color tokens meet contrast in both light/dark. current token --accent-300 fails at small text. bump to --accent-500 or increase font-weight.

marta: experiment setup: control = current banner; variant A = lighthouse pill + default copy; variant B = pill + revised copy + snooze option. primary metric: setup completion within 7 days. secondary: dismissal rate. i'll add telemetry keys: onboarding.lighthouse.view, onboarding.lighthouse.expand, onboarding.lighthouse.snooze, onboarding.step.complete.

anya: accessibility follow-ups: oliver can you supply the exact focus ring specs? kevin can you prototype keep-in-dom + aria-hidden toggle? sam will draft microcopy variants. i'll compile everything into the onboarding PRD.

deploy-bot: heads-up: onboarding design freeze this Friday 5pm PT. link final comps to the RELEASE ticket.

kevin: i'll try a lightweight prototype by Thu and ping oliver for a11y sign-off.

sam: i'll push copy variants to figma by Wed EOD. :thumbsup:

anya: thanks team 94 leaving thread open for any late concerns about focus management or contrast tokens.
